subject: How to use predict () function on a RN model with a quadratic relationship?

messages.author: c8dd8d4885268881
messages.subject: How to use predict () function on a RN model with a quadratic relationship?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I try to do an RN occupancy model and it has a quadratic interaction between the covariates. My model is occuRN(formula = ~hora ~ A_vsape_50 + I(A_vsape_50^2) + Sdt_b200,  data = abla_umf)

I understand that the newdata argument needs the data of this model, so if I want to do the prediction with Sdt_b200 I must do another variable equal to zero as follows:


#for terrain second derivative (sdt)
newData_sdt<- data.frame(Sdt_b200=Cov_Sdt, A_vsape_50=0)
preddata_sdt <- predict(ab_occRN15, 
                        newdata=newData_sdt,
                        type="state")
preddata_sdt$Sdt_b200<- Cov_Sdt

But, If I need to do the I(A_vsape_50^2) predict? How can I do it? I was searching about it on the internet but I don't find an answer... Also, if someone thinks that I have a mistake in this little script I was very thankful for any kind of comment about it
I was very thankful to someone can help me, thank you all!
